description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and coverage for different models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at powers of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", has a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Four lines are shown in the plot: Llama-3B (dark blue, solid line), Llama-3B + FT (green triangles, dashed line), Llama-1B (light blue, solid line), and Llama-1B + FT (light green triangles, dashed line). The dark blue line (Llama-3B) starts at around 0.42 at 2^0 and increases to approximately 0.94 at 2^8. The green dashed line (Llama-3B + FT) starts at around 0.43 at 2^0 and increases to approximately 0.94 at 2^8. The light blue line (Llama-1B) starts at around 0.38 at 2^0 and increases to approximately 0.9 at 2^8. The light green dashed line (Llama-1B + FT) starts at around 0.39 at 2^0 and rises to approximately 0.9 at 2^8. All four lines exhibit an overall upward trend as the number of completions (k) increases.
